verdict: Leads are coming in; none are converting — that's the focus now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 37 leads from Meta at a cost of $40.69 per lead, but zero of those contacts moved forward into an active case opportunity — the ads are working, but the intake handoff is not. Ad spend also paused for five consecutive days (Sep 9–13) before restarting on Sep 14, which drove a 29% dip in leads over the most recent week compared to the week prior. Cost per lead improved 64% week-over-week as a result of the lower spend volume, but that efficiency gain is secondary to fixing the pipeline gap. We are working to get the contact-follow-up tools in place so that incoming leads are reached and logged properly. Once that is resolved, the ad restart gives us a clean baseline to build from heading into October.

watch_item.issue: Contacts are arriving but not being converted into opportunities — the intake and follow-up process has a gap that is causing leads to go unworked.
watch_item.fix: SMS automation and phone access tools are being activated to close the contact-rate gap, and case-tracking automation is on track to be live by end of September.
